messages.subject: Théo | Mining, Energy & Industrial Executive Profile | International Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Gaultier,

I am sharing my profile for senior international mandates across mining, energy, engineering and industrial businesses.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio covers senior government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

Your executive-search work across automotive, engineering, energy, manufacturing and mining makes my background relevant to mandates where leaders must manage institutional relationships, sustainability, social licence and complex operating environments.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director and VP-track roles across External Affairs, Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Social Performance and Country Leadership. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

I have attached my global executive CV for confidential consideration.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
